title: ZeroDivisionError in telemetry aggregator
description: Our batch analytics worker crashed with: ZeroDivisionError: division by zero in calculate_average(metrics) at line 84 when processing an empty device metric stream.

title: 502 Bad Gateway during morning traffic spike
description: Nginx returns 502 Bad Gateway intermittently. Gunicorn error log reports: [CRITICAL] WORKER TIMEOUT (pid:4981) due to long-running DB queries during peak user login.

title: Duplicate charge on credit card for annual plan
description: We noticed that our corporate card was billed twice ($1,200 x 2) on October 1st for the Enterprise license. Please refund the duplicate transaction immediately or we will initiate a chargeback.

title: SQL Injection vulnerability found in user search API
description: Security audit flagged endpoint /api/users/search: raw string interpolation is used: SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = ' + user_query + '. Needs immediate remediation.

title: Out of Memory (OOMKilled) in Redis Cache Pod
description: Kubernetes cluster reported CrashLoopBackOff on redis-cache-0 with exit code 137 (OOMKilled). Memory usage spiked from 2GB to 8GB in 15 minutes.

title: KeyError: 'refresh_token' when exchanging OAuth code
description: Authentication gateway crashes with KeyError: 'refresh_token' when authenticating users via Google OAuth who did not request offline access.

title: Inquiry regarding student discount options
description: Hi team, I am a university student looking to use your platform for my thesis project. Do you offer an academic discount or free tier for students?

title: API Secret Key accidentally committed to public repo
description: Our AWS root credentials and Stripe secret key were committed into a public GitHub repository in commit 9f12ab. Need emergency rotation and security checklist.
